for the article title in Title Case. Immediately below the

tag, automatically insert a centered Google Search Preview iframe for the topic title, formatted like this:
Use

for main sections and

for subsections. Wrap all body text in

tags. The first paragraph must serve as the meta description and include the primary keyword. Maintain keyword density of 1–2% with natural use of synonyms. Mention the current year (2025) naturally in the content. Content Guidelines: SEO Optimization: - Primary keyword in the title, first 100 words, at least one

, and in the conclusion. - Write a compelling, keyword-rich introduction. - Ensure meta description is engaging and under 160 characters. Structure & Readability: - Short paragraphs (2–4 sentences). - Use bullet lists
  • and numbered lists
    1. where appropriate. - Add tables if relevant for clarity. - Ensure smooth transitions between sections. - Mobile-friendly and accessible. Links: - Include internal links (placeholder: Topic). - Include external authoritative links (e.g., Wikipedia, government, or educational sites). - Do not insert affiliate links, referral codes, or promotional CTAs. Conclusion: - Add a

      Conclusion

      section. - Restate the main keyword and summarize the key takeaways. FAQs: - End with 5–8 FAQs, each with

      for the question and

      for the answer. - Include related secondary keywords naturally in FAQ answers. Output Rules: - Output only the clean HTML article (no explanations, no , , or tags). - The article must be fully optimized, error-free, and ready to publish with no further edits required.
